closed_issues.title: Refactor: Consolidate duplicated memory allocation functions
Refactor: Replace try/except KeyError config pattern with dict.get()
Mashtree runs even when there is only one input genome
Edge case: ncbi dataset not redownloaded when changing the list of accessions for later runs
Solve all environments in conda strict mode
gapseq_fill seems to fail when running on add_refseq genomes
Missing test of duplicate sample names after merging local and refseq samples
`--status` doesn't show the intended output when different input genomes are given.
Add information on how a system admin can set a default path for the databases
Add more documentation on how to use the powerful `--until` argument
An option for higher resolution figures that can be suitbale for publication (i.e. tiff/eps/pdf)
An option for a lateral entry point for already annotated genomes (such as reference genomes)
Is only generated if `set_eggnog--decorate_gff=no` which is not default
Eggnog fails if version installed is above or equal to 2.1.7
URL to manually download the databases?
both bakta and prokka are run despite specify an annotator
Can't add more than a single string (file or glob) to the input_genomes parameter.
Follow the standard file hierarchy for a snakemake pipeline.
Remove mamba as dependency from bioconda recipe?
Option to add .faa files for analysis downstream of gene calling
gtdbtk: mash: error while loading shared libraries: libgsl.so.25: cannot open shared object file: No such file or directory
N<4, iqtree: ERROR: It makes no sense to perform bootstrap with less than 4 sequences.
rule gtdb_download: curl: (77) error setting certificate file: /etc/ssl/certs/ca-bundle.crt
Use newer uniref 100 database for kegg calling
! dev.control() called without an open graphics device
Download databases without a dummy file being present
(roary) Could not solve for environment space
Dry run fails when apptainer-compatible docker image is not already downloaded.
User should be actively warned when not using apptainer.
Files inaccessible inside apptainer environment when working in a symlinked directory
copied input files should be named *.fna, not *.fa
Remove Card and Plasmidfinder from report
Pseudo rules like interproscan and prokka could be removed
header should write the version number
rule sequence_lengths (collector) does not void the report
Some rules should not run when there is only one sample.
The report will fail if the metadata has not been created
use conda run instead of conda activate ...
Use python script instead of bash alias
pseudo reads-ize the genomes for kraken2
Considering to remove singularity support and just go with conda.
Check that kraken path exists before starting the workflow
Should only pass if the dir exists already.
Visualization of GC content throughout contigs
Pan/core legend is way too big
Resistance tables are much too wide
perl root and perl moo fails when the snakemake conda prefix variable is set
roary dir overwrites on change of thresholds
assemblycomparator (shell) and workflow (py) don't agree on the files included
Use a hash table to check if an assembly has already been annotated (prokka).
Refer to fasttree paper in apescript
